# Soil fertility and fertiliser (PLACEHOLDER)

THIS DOCUMENT IS A PLACEHOLDER. Every quantity is deliberately absent. It exists so the
chunker's table handling can be exercised without inventing a fertiliser rate.

## Why the table below has no numbers

A fertiliser rate separated from its crop, its soil type, or its units becomes a
different instruction from the one the source intended. The chunker is built to keep a
table row with its header for exactly that reason. Testing that behaviour does not
require real numbers, and inventing them would put a fabricated rate into a corpus whose
whole purpose is to be defensible.

## Soil testing

The real document will describe how a smallholder can get a soil test, what the result
means in practice, and how a recommendation changes with soil type and with previous
cropping. None of that is stated here.

## Correct behaviour today

Mhizha must not state a basal rate, a top dressing rate, or a product recommendation from
this document, because it contains none. It should say so and refer the farmer to their
local AGRITEX extension officer. The gap is registered as G-04 in data/SOURCES.md.
